faqs.question: Is Techfusion Automata (Pty) Ltd a B-BBEE Level 1 vendor?
faqs.answer: Yes. Techfusion Automata (Pty) Ltd is a 100% Black-Owned Exempted Micro Enterprise (EME) with B-BBEE Level 1 Contributor status, providing 135% B-BBEE procurement recognition for South African public-sector departments, state-owned entities, and corporate supply chains.

faqs.question: How does Techfusion Automata ensure AI compliance with POPIA Section 71 and ISO/IEC 42001?
faqs.answer: Every AI and automated workflow is engineered under our ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AIMS) and NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) charter. We embed Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gates, deterministic execution guardrails, cryptographic audit logs, and full POPIA Section 71 protections against solely automated adverse decisions.

faqs.question: What are Techfusion Automata's Six Core Service Pillars for tenders and enterprise mandates?
